"name": "Improper Certificate Validation"}], "description": "## Impact

`buildWSLegacyExecutor()` in `@graphql-tools/executor-legacy-ws` previously hardcoded `rejectUnauthorized: false` when creating WebSocket connections over WSS. This disabled TLS certificate validation, allowing a network-positioned attacker to perform a Man-in-the-Middle (MITM) attack against applications that use this executor with a `wss://` endpoint. Credentials passed via `connectionParams` or `headers` could be intercepted, and subscription data could be tampered with.

**Who is impacted:** Applications using `@graphql-tools/executor-legacy-ws` (directly or via `@graphql-tools/url-loader` with `SubscriptionProtocol.LEGACY_WS`) to connect to a `wss://` endpoint from Node.js while sending authentication material over the connection.

Browser WebSocket clients are unaffected by this option (browsers always validate certificates).

## Patches

Upgrade to `@graphql-tools/executor-legacy-ws@1.1.35` or later (and `@graphql-tools/url-loader@9.1.9` or later if you use the loader). TLS certificate validation is enabled by default. Callers that intentionally use self-signed certificates in trusted environments can opt out with `rejectUnauthorized: false`.

## Workarounds

- Prefer the modern `graphql-ws` / `SubscriptionProtocol.WS` path where possible.
- Until upgraded, avoid sending secrets over legacy WSS connections, or terminate TLS at a trusted proxy and use `ws://` only on trusted networks.
- Supply a custom `webSocketImpl` that enforces certificate validation.", "epss": {"percentage": 0.00268, "percentile": 0.17175}, "ghsa_id": "GHSA-6fw5-9hq8-w87g", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-10-05T22:56:56Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6fw5-9hq8-w87g", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-6fw5-9hq8-w87g"}, {"type": "CVE", "value": "CVE-2026-103921"}], "nvd_published_at": "2026-10-01T17:17:19Z", "published_at": "2026-10-05T22:56:56Z", "references": ["https://github.com/ardatan/graphql-tools/security/advisories/GHSA-6fw5-9hq8-w87g", "https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-103921", "https://github.com/ardatan/graphql-tools/pull/8426", "https://github.com/ardatan/graphql-tools/commit/3831a0661514c91d99971052f983552556880402", "https://github.com/ardatan/graphql-tools/releases/tag/@graphql-tools/executor-legacy-ws@1.1.35", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6fw5-9hq8-w87g"], "repository_advisory_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/ardatan/graphql-tools/security-advisories/GHSA-6fw5-9hq8-w87g", "severity": "high", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/ardatan/graphql-tools", "summary": "GraphQL Tools: TLS Certificate Validation Disabled in Legacy GraphQL WebSocket Executor", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-10-05T22:56:58Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-6fw5-9hq8-w87g", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "1.1.35", "package": {"ecosystem": "npm", "name": "@graphql-tools/executor-legacy-ws"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": "<= 1.1.34"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
